# `^BC` – Code 128 Bar Code

[Overview](../README.md) · [Libraries](../libraries/README.md) · [Commands](README.md) · [Features](../features/README.md) · [Evidence legend](../METHODOLOGY.md) · [Compare images](../../benchmarks/accuracy/README.md)


Print a Code 128 barcode with options for height, text, and checks.

Reference parameters: **o, h, f, g, e, m**. These describe the reference grammar, not a promise that any library honors every parameter. [Zebra guide, page 94](../../zpl-zbi2-pg-en.pdf).
